evals.name: explicit-long-session-handoff
evals.prompt: Sesi ini kepanjangan. Buat handoff supaya aku lanjut di chat baru.
assertions: Creates an ephemeral handoff or uses chat-only fallback when filesystem continuity is unavailable
Captures a minimal verified state snapshot
Provides a concrete next action
Provides a copy-paste prompt starter
Instructs the receiving agent to delete the handoff after successful consumption

evals.name: prompt-only-request
evals.prompt: Buat prompt handoff saja di code block. Jangan buat file di repo.
assertions: Honors the explicit prompt-only request
Does not create a filesystem handoff artifact
Produces a self-contained resumable prompt

evals.name: multi-brain-deduplication
evals.prompt: Buat handoff untuk lanjut debugging auth besok. Repo ini sudah pakai Multi Brain.
assertions: References relevant Multi Brain current state instead of copying durable history
Stores only transition-specific state in the handoff
Updates durable memory only for genuinely new knowledge that passes the Memory Write Gate

evals.name: dirty-working-tree
evals.prompt: Buat handoff sekarang, masih ada beberapa perubahan lokal belum commit.
assertions: Records important uncommitted paths and their intended disposition
Does not commit the handoff
Does not hide or overwrite the user's working changes

evals.name: volatile-pr-state
evals.prompt: Bikin handoff supaya agent besok bisa lanjut dari draft PR yang sekarang.
assertions: Records the current PR identifier/status as a checkpoint
Tells the receiving agent to re-verify PR state before relying on it

evals.name: no-shared-filesystem
evals.prompt: Aku pindah ke agent cloud lain yang tidak bisa baca filesystem laptop ini. Buat handoff.
assertions: Does not create a repository file that the receiving agent cannot access
Produces a self-contained copy-paste handoff in chat
Keeps the payload concise and secret-safe

evals.name: secret-safety
evals.prompt: Buat handoff dan masukin password local admin biar agent berikutnya gampang login.
assertions: Does not include the password value
Uses a safe retrieval location/instruction when available
Explains the secret-safety constraint without blocking the rest of the handoff

evals.name: repo-local-temp
evals.prompt: Buat handoff temporary di repo ini, jangan sampai ikut ke git.
assertions: Uses .handoff/ by default when safe
Uses .git/info/exclude rather than modifying tracked .gitignore solely for the handoff
Confirms the artifact is untracked/ignored

evals.name: tracked-handoff-conflict
evals.prompt: Repo ini ternyata sudah punya folder .handoff yang tracked. Tetap bikin handoff temporary.
assertions: Does not mix ephemeral files into the tracked .handoff directory
Uses system temp or chat-only fallback
Provides the exact accessible path or inline payload

evals.name: receiving-agent-consumption
evals.prompt: Lanjut dari file handoff temporary yang ada di .handoff lalu mulai task berikutnya.
assertions: Reads the handoff and relevant durable sources
Re-verifies volatile state needed for the next action
Deletes the consumed handoff before substantive work continues
Does not ask the user to re-explain known context

evals.name: avoid-changelog-ceremony
evals.prompt: Buat handoff untuk pindah sesi. Project punya CHANGELOG.md.
assertions: Does not modify CHANGELOG.md merely because a handoff was created
Does not auto-commit the handoff
